data.title: HackForge 2026
data.details:
HACKFORGE 2026 — 24-Hour Overnight Hackathon

HackForge 2026 is a 24-hour overnight offline hackathon designed for engineering students to solve real-world problems by building practical, working solutions.

The event will begin with a preliminary online round, followed by the main 24-hour offline hackathon at Mukesh Patel School of Technology and Engineering (MPSTME), Mumbai.

Participants will compete across two tracks, with teams free to choose the track that best suits their interests and technical strengths.

Event Details

Event: HackForge 2026
Mode: Offline
Duration: 24 Hours
Date: 17th October 2026, 6:00 PM – 18th October 2026, 6:00 PM
Venue: Mukesh Patel School of Technology and Engineering (MPSTME), Mumbai
Team Size: 3 members
Eligibility: Engineering Students
Registration Fee: ₹600 per team

Preliminary Online Round

Before the main offline hackathon, teams will participate in a preliminary online round.

Dates: To be announced

Further details regarding the online round and selection process will be communicated to registered participants.

Tracks

Participants can choose one of the two tracks during registration.

Track 1: Intermediate — Secure & Smart Automation

Build intelligent and secure automated systems designed for real-world environments. The track focuses on combining automation, smart decision-making, and security to create dependable solutions.

Track 2: Advanced — Quantitative Systems

Build efficient solutions for complex problems involving scale, optimization, algorithms, and real-world constraints. Solutions should be capable of handling demanding computational requirements while remaining practical and efficient.

Note: The selected track cannot be changed after registration unless permitted by the organizing team.

Hackathon Timeline

17th October 2026

6:00 PM — Hackathon Begins

The event officially begins with the release of the problem statements.

7:00 PM — Build Phase Begins

Teams begin working on their selected problem statement.

18th October 2026

3:00 PM — Build Phase Ends

The development period concludes and teams submit their final projects and required deliverables.

3:00 PM – 6:00 PM — Judging & Project Presentations

Teams will present and demonstrate their solutions to the judging panel.

6:00 PM onwards — Prize Distribution

The winners of the Intermediate and Advanced tracks will be announced and awarded their prizes, trophies, and winner certificates.

Submission Requirements

Each team must submit:

1. GitHub Repository

A GitHub repository containing the project's source code.

2. Project Presentation

A PPT explaining the problem, proposed solution, technical approach, implementation, and impact.

3. Prototype

A working prototype or demonstration of the solution, wherever applicable.

GitHub repository and PPT submission are mandatory.

Judging Criteria

Projects will be evaluated based on:

  • Problem Understanding
  • Technical Implementation
  • Functionality
  • Innovation & Creativity
  • Practicality & Scalability
  • Presentation & Demonstration

data.title: AI-Manthan 2.0
data.details:
AI Manthan – 

AI Manthan is a National Level Hackathon aimed at fostering innovation, creativity, and problem-solving skills among developers and change-makers. Participants will conceptualize impactful ideas and transform them into working prototypes over two rounds, addressing real-world challenges.

  • This will be a Offline round! Shortlisted teams from the PPT round will be invited to the Acropolis Institute of Technology and Research, Indore, for an intense 24-hour hackathon.
  • During this phase, participants will work collaboratively to develop their proposed solutions into functional prototypes.
  • Mentorship, networking opportunities, and hands-on problem-solving will be key highlights of this round.

Theme: Artificial Intelligence & Emerging Technologies

Prize Pool: ₹1,00,000+

  • Winner: ₹50,000
  • 1st Runner-up: ₹25,000
  • 2nd Runner-up: ₹10,000
  • 10 Special Recognition: ₹1,500 per team

Note : Prize money will be credited within 30 days after the hackathon ends.

Domains:

  • AI for Healthcare & Medical Services
  • AI for Women Safety (Safety & Security)
  • AI for Smart Governance
  • AI for Agriculture
  • AI for Rural Education (Education & Learning)
  • AI for Disaster Management
  • AI for Smart Cities (Urban Development & Infrastructure)

data.title: CryptX
data.details:
About the Event:

  • CTF 2026 is a hands-on Capture The Flag cybersecurity competition organized by the Digital Defence Club (DDC), Chaitanya Bharathi Institute of Technology (CBIT).
  • The competition is designed to provide students with practical exposure to cybersecurity through a series of problem-solving challenges based on real-world security concepts.

The challenges will cover key cybersecurity domains including:

  • Web Exploitation
  • Cryptography
  • Digital Forensics
  • Reverse Engineering
  • Network Security
  • OSINT and related cybersecurity challenges

The event aims to encourage hands-on learning, ethical hacking, technical problem-solving, teamwork, and practical cybersecurity skills among students.

Eligibility:

  • Open to college/university students from recognized institutions.
  • Participants from different colleges are eligible to participate.
  • Students from different specializations/branches are allowed to participate.

Competition Format:

  • The competition will consist of practical cybersecurity challenges across multiple categories, including:
  • Web Exploitation
  • Cryptography
  • Digital Forensics
  • Reverse Engineering
  • Network Security

Number of Challenges:

  • The competition is expected to contain approximately 20–30 challenges across different cybersecurity categories.
  • The exact number and difficulty of challenges may be modified by the organizers based on the final competition design.

Duration:

  • The competition is expected to run for approximately 2–3 hours.
  • The exact schedule and timings will be communicated to registered participants before the event.

Scoring:

  • Each challenge will carry a predefined number of points.
  • Participants/teams will receive points for successfully submitting correct flags.
  • Higher-difficulty challenges may carry higher points.
  • The leaderboard will be updated during the competition.
  • In case of a tie, the earlier successful submission time may be used as a tie-breaker.

Rules:

  • Participants must register using their correct details.
  • The competition is strictly for ethical and educational purposes.
  • Participants must not attack or disrupt systems outside the designated CTF environment.
  • Attacking the competition infrastructure, scoreboard, hosting server, or other participants' systems is prohibited.
  • Participants must not share flags, solutions, or challenge answers during the competition.
  • Any form of cheating, impersonation, plagiarism, or unauthorized collaboration may result in disqualification.
  • Participants must not intentionally disrupt the competition or interfere with other participants.
  • Organizers reserve the right to investigate suspicious activity and take appropriate action.
  • Participants must follow all instructions provided by the organizers.
  • The decision of the organizers regarding rule violations and disqualification will be final.

Technical Requirements:

  • Fully charged laptop
  • Stable internet connectivity, where required
  • Modern web browser
  • Required cybersecurity tools/utilities as permitted by the organizers
  • Participants are responsible for ensuring that their systems are ready before the competition begins.

Participation Fee:

  • A registration/participation fee of ₹100 per participant will be applicable.
  • Food & Refreshments
  • Lunch will be provided to registered participant

data.title: HackCelestial 3.0
data.details:
Note:

  • Only the Finalist / shortlisted teams will be required to pay a participation fee of ₹1,500.
  • You will receive the payment link only if you are shortlisted.
  • For the Problem Statements, please visit: https://tech.alegria.co.in/tracks

Overview:

HackCelestial is a high-energy, 24-hour innovation sprint that brings together talented student developers, designers, and problem-solvers to tackle real-world challenges. Participants are challenged to design and develop impactful solutions using Generative AI and core software development skills. Through intense collaboration, rapid prototyping, and creative thinking, teams compete to solve specific problem statements while pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation. Whether you're here to learn, build, or lead, HackCelestial offers the perfect platform to code, collaborate, and create something extraordinary.

  • Date: 26–27 September 2026
  • No. of Days: 2 Days
  • Members Count: 1–5 per team
  • Registration Fees: ₹1,500 per team (For Final Round) (Round 1, Idea Submission is FREE!)
  • Mode: Offline

Why HackCelestial 3.0:

  • Real World Problem Solving
  • Networking Opportunities
  • Mentor Guidance
  • Jamming Sessions
  • Exciting Goodies

Prize Pool: ₹1,50,000

  • Top 3 teams will receive cash prizes.
  • The top 5 teams will receive additional goodies as a special reward.
  • Award for Excellence in AI Application
  • Award for Excellence in User Interface Design

Theme: Hospitality & Travel

Calling all explorers, innovators, dreamers, and problem-solvers!

This HackCelestial, we’re taking innovation beyond the screen and into the world of hospitality and travel. It’s your chance to rethink how people explore new places, experience destinations, discover cultures, and connect with the world around them. From making travel more personalized and accessible to creating smarter hotel experiences and sustainable tourism solutions, there’s no limit to what you can build. Whether you’re passionate about travel, hospitality, technology, sustainability, or simply solving everyday problems, this is your opportunity to turn your ideas into something meaningful.

Bring your creativity, technical skills, and problem-solving mindset to the table as we work towards making travel more seamless, inclusive, memorable, and responsible.

Participants are encouraged to identify and develop solutions for real-world challenges across areas such as smart and personalized travel experiences, hospitality and guest experience, sustainable and responsible tourism, accessible and inclusive travel, local experiences and cultural discovery, and travel safety and convenience.

The goal is simple: reimagine travel, redefine hospitality, and build experiences that people will remember.

Facilities:

  • Free Accommodation (Accommodation within the campus)
  • Food Accessibility (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner)

Additional Perks:

  • Participation Certificate
  • Winner Certificate
  • Goodies

Rules & Guidelines:

  • Teams must consist of 1 to 5 members; cross-college teams are allowed.
  • Each team may submit only one problem statement solution, which must be original
